Implement module escape_frame with clk,rst_n and ports {"inputs": [["feed", 1], ["symbol", 2], ["flush", 1]], "outputs": [["active", 1], ["escaped", 1], ["work_sum", 2], ["work_count", 2], ["last_sum", 2], ["last_count", 2], ["completed", 1]]}
Specification:
Escaped token frame parser on rising clk edges, async active-low reset clears every output. Tokens: 0 START, 1 END, 2 ESC, 3 DATA. Every rising edge clears completed. flush dominates feed: abort active frame, clear active/escaped/work_sum/work_count, preserve last_sum/last_count. Else feed=0 holds every other output, including escaped. Outside a frame only fed START opens a frame with zero work_sum/work_count and escaped=0. In an active frame, if escaped=1, ANY fed symbol is literal payload (even START/END/ESC), XOR its unsigned value into work_sum, increment work_count modulo four, clear escaped. Otherwise START restarts work_sum/work_count at zero; END commits work_sum/work_count to last_sum/last_count, pulses completed, clears active/escaped and work outputs; ESC sets escaped without consuming payload; DATA adds literal 3 by XOR and modulo-four count. Commit preserves last results until another commit or reset. Exposed work and active outputs hold between rising edges; falling edges and input-only changes have no effect. All binary inputs defined.
